summary: 26-year-old paraglider Mitchell Stubbs reported missing by his father late Friday night after failing to return to camp north of Deep Lake; Garfield County Search and Rescue found and rescued him over the weekend.
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE - KMTS archive page 284 (opened live, parent-verified): story states 'reported missing by his father late Friday night'; page context (Hayden Pass Fire evacuations Jul 11 2016, Von Miller deal Jul 15 2016) pins publication ~Jul 18-19 2016, so Friday = 2016-07-15.
